rebalancer.rule: Back to 50/50 when the NEAR weight, valued at the last daily close, drifts more than 10 points.

trend.rule: All NEAR when the last daily close is above its 50-day average, all USDC when below.

breakout.rule: Enter on a close above the prior 55-day high and keep buying toward all NEAR until a close below the prior 20-day low; then keep selling toward all USDC until the next entry. In or out is the side of the vault's last on-chain trade request.

hold.rule: Move to 50/50 once, then never trade: once the vault has any on-chain trade request, it only holds.

luck.rule: Random trades under the same limits: each tick, with probability 0.25, buy or sell 10-50% of the remaining cap (per trade and rolling 24 h). The randomness is sha256(seed|vault|seq|slot block hash): the vault's own decision number and the hash of the first block at or after the scheduled slot, which nobody knows earlier.

vol-target.rule: NEAR weight = 40% annual volatility divided by NEAR's realised volatility over the last 30 daily closes, capped at 90%. Trades only when the target is more than 10 points from the current weight.
